body.name: Certified numerical padding \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{num}}\)
body.construction: On \(\kappa_n=0\), \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{num}}=\Delta_n^{\mathrm{enc}}+\Delta_n^{\mathrm{arith}}\), where \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{enc}}\) propagates the deterministic coordinate error \(2^{-p_n-1}\) from \(\mathsf{Enc}_{p_n,L_n}\), and \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{arith}}\) sums the nonnegative outward radii recorded by \(H_n^{\mathrm{cert}}\) for retained-SVD and pseudoinverse enclosure, gate classification, normal and chi-square quantiles, scalar calibration, and final endpoint rounding; on \(\kappa_n=1\), \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{num}}=M_0\).
